# ⚡ Mistyy Plugin - Death Ban & Revive System

**Warning! This Project Is Vice Coded It May Have Bugs, Use At Your Own Risk!!**

---

## 📖 About

This Plugin Adds:
- **Death Ban System** - If You Get Killed Or Die You Will Be Banned
- **Revive Beacon** - Revive Death Banned Players (Only 9 Slots Per Inventory So Use It Wisely)
- **Wemmbu's Fishing Rod** - Using `/boom stab|nuke|stab_shulker|nuke_shulker` Customizable Via `config.yml`
- **Admin Commands** - `/reviveplayer <player>` For Ops And Console

This Was Supposed To Be A Simple Private Project But I Released It Since It Wasn't Being Used Anymore.

I Would Recemmend Instant Respawn On

---

## 🎮 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/revive` | Open The Revive Crafting Menu | Everyone |
| `/reviveplayer <player>` | Revive A Player By Name | `mistyy.revive` (Op Only) |
| `/boom stab` | Get A Stab Fishing Rod | `mistyy.boom` |
| `/boom nuke` | Get A Nuke Fishing Rod | `mistyy.boom` |
| `/deathban toggle` | Enable/Disable Death Bans | `mistyy.admin` |
| `/deathban status` | Check If Death Bans Are Enabled | `mistyy.admin` |
| `/deathban unban <player>` | Manually Unban A Player | `mistyy.admin` |
| `/deathban list` | List All Banned Players | `mistyy.admin` |
| `/setrevivespawn` | Set The Revive Spawn Location | `mistyy.setrevivespawn` |

---

## 🔧 How To Install

1. **Setup Your Server**
   - Make Sure It's **Paper** Or **Purpur**
   - Run The Server Once
   - You Should See A `plugins/` Folder

2. **Install The Plugin**
   - Put `Mistyy.jar` Inside The `plugins/` Folder
   - Restart Or Reload Your Server

3. **Configure**
   - Edit `plugins/Mistyy/config.yml` To Your Liking

**This Plugin Does Not Require Any Dependencies!**

---

## 🔨 Revive Beacon Crafting Recipe

Do `/revive` To Open The Revive Crafting Menu

![Revive Beacon Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e314eb9355bb2854105d4cb334968e623856512a.png)

### Recipe Layout:
Diamond | Diamond | Diamond
Totem | Netherite Ingot | Totem
Iron Block | Iron Block | Iron Block

**REMINDER: PUT A NETHERITE INGOT IN THE MIDDLE FOR IT TO WORK!**

---

## ⚙️ Configuration (`config.yml`)

```yaml
# Custom Death Message (%player% = Player Name)
death-message: "§c☠ %player% has fallen..."

# Enable/Disable Death Ban System
deathBanToggle: true

# Revive Spawn Location (Where Players Spawn After Revival)
revive-spawn:
  world: "world"
  x: 0.0
  y: 70.0
  z: 0.0
  yaw: 0.0
  pitch: 0.0

# Legacy Offset (If No Spawn Location Is Set)
revive-teleport-offset:
  x: 0
  y: 70
  z: 0
